coverage_rule: A component is COVERED only when its exact source entry point is bundled, at least one Skill route exists, every declared runtime command exists, and its authority boundary is explicit.

components.name: Methodology Specification Phases 00-11
components.authority_limit: The Skill may route and prepare lifecycle work; only the Product OS Authority approves phase or baseline transitions.

components.name: Master Lifecycle Index
components.authority_limit: The Skill reports lifecycle position and routing without declaring a phase complete.

components.name: Master Artifact Catalog
components.authority_limit: The Skill may select and scaffold cataloged artifacts; it may not invent or retire canonical artifact identities.

components.name: Standards and Compliance Applicability
components.authority_limit: The Skill may surface applicability candidates and propagation; a human authority approves applicability and NOT_APPLICABLE dispositions.

components.name: Gate Map
components.authority_limit: The Skill may prepare gate inputs and report evidence gaps; it never records an approval as its own decision.

components.name: Cross-Phase Traceability
components.authority_limit: The Skill may calculate and report lineage; it may not waive a missing required link.

components.name: Core Artifact Contracts
components.authority_limit: The Skill must preserve shared and specialized contracts; exceptions require governed change authority.

components.name: Classification Rules
components.authority_limit: The Skill applies canonical classifications and reports conflicts; it does not redefine the taxonomy.

components.name: Gate Specifications
components.authority_limit: Automation can determine mechanical readiness only; gate disposition remains a named human authority decision.

components.name: Traceability Graph
components.authority_limit: The Skill may derive graph views but may not treat derived views as canonical source records.

components.name: Change Impact Rules
components.authority_limit: The Skill may propose impact dispositions; NO_IMPACT and accepted residual risk require human approval.

components.name: Source and Evidence Model
components.authority_limit: The Skill may register and assess evidence fitness; it must not fabricate evidence or attest compliance.

components.name: AI Operating Specification
components.authority_limit: The Skill operates only in delegated modes and must preserve attribution, uncertainty, evidence, and human control.

components.name: Spec Kit Figma GitHub Mapping
components.authority_limit: The Skill records exact native-object identities and synchronization state; it does not replace native sources with summaries.

components.name: Schemas and Repository Standard
components.authority_limit: The Skill may apply published schemas and migrations with explicit mutation consent; destructive or authority actions remain blocked.

components.name: Automation and Commands
components.authority_limit: Commands produce mechanical results and evidence; they do not create human approval or expand delegated authority.

components.name: Synthetic Reference Pilot
components.authority_limit: Synthetic pilot evidence proves framework mechanics only; it cannot be represented as production validation.
